description: This Python module defines adapter interfaces and factory functions for external services such as repositories, Airflow, and Kubernetes. It includes abstract base classes, data containers, and functions to obtain adapter instances, facilitating decoupling and plugin support for various vendor-specific SDKs.

classes.name: BaseRepoAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for repository providers (e.g., GitLab, GitHub, Bitbucket).

classes.name: RepoInfo
classes.description: Data class containing information about a repository.

classes.name: BaseAirflowAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for Airflow orchestration clients.

classes.name: DagRunInfo
classes.description: Data class containing information about a DAG run in Airflow.

classes.name: BaseKubernetesAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for Kubernetes integration.

methods.name: get_repo_adapter_factory
methods.description: Factory function to obtain a repository adapter instance.

methods.name: get_airflow_adapter
methods.description: Function to get an Airflow adapter instance.

methods.name: get_kubernetes_adapter
methods.description: Function to get a Kubernetes adapter instance.
